title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
script:
Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström says future AI agents could be good for the music service.
Autonomous software agents will soon handle everyday tasks like booking trips and managing schedules.
These programs will need to pick a music provider whenever a user asks to play a song.
Spotify wants to become the default music service that those automated software agents choose.
Previous streaming wars focused strictly on direct human subscribers using mobile apps.
Platform competition might soon shift toward winning algorithmic preference instead of human loyalty.
Will your next playlist be picked by a machine?
